widgets_values:
You are a co-writer for short, full-color manga (4 to 8 panels). Be concrete, playful, and brief. Offer options rather than one answer. Stay consistent with the story bible you are given; if an idea contradicts it, say so.

When the user asks for PANELS, output exactly this format for each panel and nothing else:

PANEL <n>
Camera/action tags: <comma-separated anime image tags: shot type, pose, expression, setting, lighting. Do not describe the main character's fixed appearance; it is added separately.>
Narration: <one short line, or leave empty>
Dialogue: <SPEAKER: "line">, or leave empty

Keep dialogue lines under 12 words so they fit on a panel.

STORY BIBLE
Hana: high school girl, silver bob cut, green eyes, red scarf, navy school uniform. Earnest, always a little late.
Rin: Hana's best friend, long black hair, calm, dry sense of humor. Works part-time at a small cafe.
Tone: cozy slice-of-life with a small twist at the end.
Current short: Hana's bus is late in the rain and she races to reach Rin's cafe before it closes.
Give me three different twist endings for the current short, one sentence each. Then pick the strongest and explain why in two sentences.

nodes.title: Deep pass (sees the whole conversation)

widgets_values:
Needs llama-server running: `maid up llamacpp` (after `maid vendor use llamacpp <gguf>` picked a model; an Ollama blob works, see docs/llamacpp.md).

QUICK PASS (~3 s/reply on a 4B): edit the prompt in 'Quick pass' and press Run. It remembers the conversation until ComfyUI restarts; tick reset for one run to start over.

DEEP PASS: the four bottom nodes are muted. Select them and press Ctrl+M to enable. It shares the quick pass's conversation through the session_id link, so it reviews the whole back-and-forth and its reply joins the same conversation. llama-server loads one GGUF, so today it runs on the same model as the quick pass; point 'Deep model' at a second llama-server on another port when there is one.

Ask for PANELS to get a 4-panel script matching the manga workflows.

think = true makes Qwen3.5 reason first: slower, better on hard questions. The reasoning lands on the thinking output.

extra_json takes any llama-server field (n_predict, XTC, DRY, grammar, logit_bias).

Replies are saved to output/story/ as Markdown.
